items.title: Platform Foundation
items.description: One codebase, PostgreSQL, a wall between companies, an audit log that only grows, and money stored in cents.

items.title: Sign-In, Users And Roles
items.description: A person signs in, gets a role, and only sees what that role allows.

items.title: Sign In By Email
items.description: A person signs in with email and password, and picks a company only when the email belongs to more than one.

items.title: Hosted Preview
items.description: A free Render site so the apps can be opened on a phone or a computer.

items.title: Control Panel
items.description: A separate sign-in for platform staff to add a client, its people, and its modules.

items.title: Contacts
items.description: One list for customers, suppliers, and staff.

items.title: Branches And Legal Entities
items.description: A company starts with one head office. More branches can be switched on later.

items.title: Custom Fields And Pipelines
items.description: Extra fields, status steps, and in-app alerts that other modules can use.

items.title: Inventory
items.description: Products, services, quantities on hand, and a record of every stock movement.

items.title: Label Print Page
items.description: Print a stock label from inside the app, at the size of the label.

items.title: Spreadsheet Import
items.description: Bring contacts and stock in from Excel or CSV, and take a copy back out.

items.title: MFA On/Off Switch
items.description: The preview can skip the authenticator. Switch it back on before real client data.

items.title: Calm UI And Tabbed Control Panel
items.description: A quieter light theme, and the client screen split into tabs.

items.title: Calculated Fields And Automations
items.description: A field that works out its own value, and rules an operator can switch on.

items.title: Snap A Document
items.description: Photograph or upload a supplier invoice or a delivery note, check the fields, receive the stock, and print labels.

items.title: GRV Barcode Labels And Scanner
items.description: Print a batch of Niimbot labels from a goods received note, and scan them with a Lumni scanner.

items.title: Build Progress
items.description: One place on Overview for what is done, what is being built, and what is still coming.

items.title: One UI Standard
items.description: One calm light interface for the company app and the control panel, with the full module index.

items.title: Dynamic Report Builder
items.description: A Reports section where you pick the data, columns, filters, and grouping, then save or export the report.

items.title: Standard Document Reader
items.description: An included reader for supplier invoices and delivery notes, for companies that do not want the extra fee.

items.title: Demo Polish
items.description: Title Case on the remaining buttons and labels, and custom fields on the stock item screen.

items.title: People Page And Plain Language
items.description: People, roles, and segregation rules use plain words, toggles, and one quiet menu per row.

items.title: Phone Experience
items.description: The phone is for sales, stock, documents, and contacts, with setup left on a computer.

items.title: Sales: Quotes, Invoices And Payments
items.description: Quotes, tax invoices, credit notes, and customer payments, with a statement and an aged debtors report.

items.title: Import Table Cleanup
items.description: Remove the old stand-in tables for contacts and stock. Imports already save into the real lists.

items.title: Paid Hosting And MFA Back On
items.description: Move off the free preview, and turn the authenticator back on, before any real client data.

items.title: Quotes
items.description: Track a lead and send a price a customer can accept.

items.title: Invoicing
items.description: Customer accounts, tax invoices, credit notes, receipts, payment allocation, statements, ageing, FIN-01 posting, customer credit limits/holds and an auditable overdue-reminder queue. Recurring invoice scheduling and outbound reminder email delivery remain follow-on work.

items.title: General Ledger
items.description: A chart of accounts, balanced journals from sales and stock, the main reports, and a guided import for opening balances.

items.title: Accounts Payable Posting
items.description: A captured supplier bill can now be posted to FIN-01 expense, VAT-input and creditors-control accounts; credit notes and purchase-order/GRN matching remain.

items.title: Customer And Supplier Portals
items.description: A link a customer or supplier can open to see their own documents.

items.title: Dashboards And Reports
items.description: The numbers for the modules a company has switched on.

items.title: Creditors
items.description: Separate creditors module now has supplier-bill capture, FIN-01 bill posting, supplier payments and allocations, ageing, tenant-scoped APIs and a company-app screen. Credit notes, PO/GRN three-way matching, payment approvals, EFT/remittance exports and full workflow tests remain.

items.title: Cashbook And Bank Reconciliation
items.description: Separate cashbook module now has bank-account setup, idempotent statement-line import, FIN-01 journal matching, reconciliation balances and completion controls, tenant-scoped APIs and a company-app screen. CSV upload, live bank feeds, split allocations and full integration tests remain.

items.title: Petty Cash And Expense Claims
items.description: Separate petty-cash module now has fund/float controls, balanced cash movement postings, receipt-backed expense claims, approval/rejection/payment postings, tenant-scoped APIs and a company-app screen. Document-capture linking, workflow/approval-limit integration, payroll adapter and full tests remain.

items.title: VAT And Tax
items.description: Separate tax module now has configurable tax codes, VAT transaction validation, period preparation, filing reference capture, locking, tenant-scoped APIs and a company-app screen. VAT201 mapping, SARS export, automatic source adapters, GL VAT reconciliation and compliance review remain.

items.title: Sales Orders
items.description: Reserve stock, deliver it, and invoice what went out.

items.title: Procurement
items.description: Ask a supplier for a price and raise a purchase order.

items.title: Point Of Sale
items.description: Sell at the counter, split the payment, and cash up the till.

items.title: Recurring Bills And Rentals
items.description: Send the same invoice each month, and track equipment that is out on hire.

items.title: Support, Returns And Warranties
items.description: Log a problem, a return, or a warranty claim.

items.title: Warehousing And Stocktakes
items.description: Put goods in a bin, pick from that bin, and count what is there.

items.title: Dispatch And Fleet
items.description: Load deliveries onto a vehicle and keep the signed proof of delivery.

items.title: Manufacturing
items.description: Issue parts to a work order and take the finished goods back into stock.

items.title: Job Cards
items.description: Collect parts, hours, and cash spent against one job.

items.title: Assets And Maintenance
items.description: The asset register, depreciation, and a service before a breakdown.

items.title: Quality Checks
items.description: Inspect goods on arrival and record what failed.

items.title: Employee Records
items.description: The staff file, who they report to, and the steps to start someone.

items.title: Time And Shifts
items.description: Rosters, clock-in, overtime, and leave.

items.title: Payroll
items.description: A pay run, a payslip, and PAYE, UIF, and SDL.

items.title: Staff Documents
items.description: An employment contract or a warning filled in from the staff file.

items.title: Staff Welfare
items.description: Staff loans, and notes that stay hidden from people who should not see them.

items.title: Employment Equity And B-BBEE
items.description: Equity counts and the B-BBEE scorecard.

items.title: COIDA And POPIA
items.description: COIDA earnings, a UI-19 when someone leaves, and POPIA consent.

items.title: Health And Safety
items.description: Incidents, PPE handed out, and contracts that are about to end.

items.title: Projects
items.description: Tasks, dates, and a budget next to what was spent.

items.title: IT Assets And Helpdesk
items.description: Who has which laptop, which software seats are in use, and internal IT tickets.

items.title: FIN-06: validate real VAT period dates
items.description: Rejects impossible financial period or payment dates with regression coverage.
